_about: Public-domain John Dick (1764-1833, Secession Church, professor of theology at Glasgow) for the Word Hoard: Lectures on the Acts of the Apostles (2nd ed., New York, 1857), clean from CCEL; and from the Internet Archive his Lectures on Theology (Edinburgh: Oliphant, 4 vols, 1834, the first edition) and An Essay on the Inspiration of the Holy Scriptures (Boston, 1811, with W. Parry's essay). Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 15 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
